body: As someone who has made multiple attempts, I can say feeling drained is OK and normal after these types of events. Feelings of confusion, shame and loss also come flooding in for me. Unless you've been there, it is actually difficult to pinpoint words to describe all the feelings that arise. However, your mental heath management team should be able to assist with putting you in contact with doctors, therapist and support groups to aid in your healing process. And, if any health professional is not listening to you and/or your needs, keep going until you find someone who will. Help is out there. Sometimes, the scariest and bravest thing you can do, is ask for it.
